success_output_law.name: F_TOPK-U
success_output_law.runtime_share_law: For M_runtime: sample z0 uniformly from {0,1}^n; set z1=z0 XOR M_runtime; party b receives only z_b.
success_output_law.basis: S25 inverse shuffle e0/e1 include -h/+h; output is word1 LSB; ideal independent random tape yields uniform per-party shares whose XOR is M_runtime.
success_output_law.ideal_target: F_TOPK-U for stable Top-K mask M; functional equivalence requires M_runtime=M.
success_output_law.runtime_rng_assumption: OS getrandom/OpenSSL RAND_bytes joint computational distribution and epsilon_rng_joint are NOT_QUANTIFIED.
success_output_law.correctness_scope: S27 finite functional receipt does not prove equality for all allowed inputs and random tapes.

approved_L: sample seed for each active iteration only after forward shuffle
ideal_functionality.scope: S30 does not add fields to the approved L; v3 preservation of exact declassification/length semantics remains conditional and unproven.

abort_output_contract.evidence_limit: S25 crash tests establish NO_COMPLETE_MASK for tested prefixes only; they do not establish atomic no-output or all-or-nothing.

options.name: F_TOPK-PREFIX
options.contract: A party gets its local share iff its API returns; otherwise its ideal output is bottom. The other party may already have returned.

options.name: F_TOPK-ATOMIC
options.contract: Both parties receive shares iff both atomically publish; otherwise both outputs are bottom.
options.code_evidence: Not implied by local durable markers or NO_COMPLETE_MASK.
